profiles.name: quick
profiles.description: Fast lightweight inventory scan for quick local visibility.
accuracy_notes: May leave more hosts unknown or weakly classified.

profiles.name: balanced
profiles.description: Default v1.8-compatible profile for routine DeltaAegis telemetry.
accuracy_notes: Preserves lightweight behavior expected by DeltaAegis.
Uses curated TCP service detection without expensive optional probes.

profiles.name: accurate
profiles.description: Higher-evidence profile for improved local device classification.
accuracy_notes: Adds stronger service probing and optional OS evidence.
OS detection must be treated as weak/supporting evidence only.
UDP-lite is limited to common local-network discovery services.

profiles.name: deep
profiles.description: Slow manual-only profile for explicit operator-driven deep inspection.
accuracy_notes: Must not be used as the DeltaAegis default scheduled profile.
Still avoids intrusive scripts by default.
